question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Bind
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Bind"** means to tie or fasten something tightly. (बांधना)

 
 
• **Example: **The ropes were used to **bind** the logs together.
 
 
 
• **"Secure" **refers to making something safe or ensuring it is firmly attached. (सुरक्षित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He used a padlock to **secure** the gate.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Bind' **is **'Secure'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Amuse **(मनोरंजन करना): To entertain or make someone laugh.

 
 
• **Example:** The clown's antics never fail to **amuse** the children.
 
 
 
• **Flourish **(फूलना-फलना): To grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way.
 
 
• **Example: **The plants **flourished** in the rich soil.
 
 
 
• **Disengage** (अलग करना): To release or detach from something.
 
 
• **Example:** He tried to **disengage** himself from the conversation.

The correct answer is** Option 2)**
